Name: (CP Livestock) Regular Goose
Author: Luzze42
Description:
Just regular white geese, really. Nothing special!

This mod adds white geese for sale at Marnies'.

They need a lot of space, you can only put them into deluxe coops. Their chicks are slightly bigger than a regular chickens' and they might take a while to fully grow up.
Once grown they shed their feathers - for you profit! If you're lucky you might also find one of their big eggs.
Those eggs are slightly too large for your mayonnaise machnine - don't try to bother with it. Besides - mayonnaise tastes awful ;)

There also might be a surprise if you try to breed them! (<- currently not working :'( )

The mod also adds their produce:

- Down
- Goose Egg
- Golden Goose Egg
and, if you're using the Animal Husbandry Mod:
- Goose
